label_rule: Rule E1 (docs/quality/22_EVAL_DATASETS.md section 1.2): every expectation here is written from the artifact bytes in demo/artifacts/ and from docs/CANONICAL_DECISIONS.md, never from what a model produced. A label copied from a run is a regression snapshot wearing a label's clothes. evals/tests/test_extraction_gold.py asserts every money figure and every excluded token actually occurs (or does not occur) in the source bytes, so a label invented to agree with the output fails its own test.
coverage: 3 of the 34 hero artifacts. The other 31 have no recorded extraction; the suite reports them CANNOT RUN and names what they would need. Scoring them is 31 live Gemini calls, not a code change.
